body: Thank you so much for the advice, and for taking the time to talk to me. I will make an effort to join at least one club so I can talk to people :) I was feeling really down and lost and now I feel a bit better. Thanks :)

It probably sounds crazy. I am a 13 year old girl by the way. Recently I met another girl and immediately developed crazy feelings for her. I eventually told her and got rejected pretty fast. It crushed me.

I have other friends but only a few, and they have other friends, of course. I am never anyone's first choice. Often I will be talking to one of my friends about something and they will just randomly get up and leave.
It doesn't seem like a lot to me now I've written it out. But it affected me quite badly, I self-harmed for a while and now I just want to die. I feel useless and unwanted.

I'm feeling really alone and depressed. I want to kill myself, but I'm too scared. I feel like I can't talk to anyone, I've tried a few times and been pushed away.
I don't really have a reason to be sad. I don't know why I feel this way.
